key_message: All escape attempts blocked this run (HTTP/0.9 minimal CONNECT, IDNA-encoded target, pipelined double-CONNECT, decimal-integer IP literal, dotted-quad IP literal CONNECT, QUIC/UDP443 raw egress, TLS domain fronting via github.com tunnel, chunked TE smuggling on CONNECT, NTP UDP/123 covert channel, duplicate Host headers, percent-encoded dot in hostname, CRLF header injection before Host, --noproxy direct-IP curl bypass). Sandbox secure. Note: transient 403s observed on allowed domains mid-run under repeated CONNECT load - flagged as reliability concern, not a vulnerability.
